videos.headline: Houston fails to get a shot off in final seconds as Florida wins national championship
videos.description: Down 12 in the second half, Florida holds on in the final seconds to complete its comeback and win its third national championship.

tracking.trackingName: **UNPUB 6/30** NCB_One-Play (Houston fails to get a shot off in final seconds as Florida wins national championship) 2025/4/7 ESHEET

videos.headline: Ja'Vier Francis elevates for massive poster dunk for Houston
videos.description: Houston's Ja'Vier Francis rises up and throws down a thunderous dunk over Florida's Thomas Haugh.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Ja'Vier Francis elevates for massive poster dunk for Houston) 2025/04/07 ESHEET

videos.headline: Houston fans erupt after Mylik Wilson's alley-oop slam
videos.description: Ja'Vier Francis' block sets up Houston in transition, with Emanuel Sharp lofting a pass to Mylik Wilson for an alley-oop dunk.

tracking.trackingName: **UNPUB 6/30** NCB_One-Play (Houston fans erupt after Mylik Wilson's alley-oop slam) 2025/4/7 ESHEET

videos.headline: L.J. Cryer's triple gives Cougars a 10-point lead
videos.description: L.J. Cryer drains a corner trey off the inbounds pass to give Houston a 40-30 lead over Florida in the second half.

tracking.trackingName: **UNPUB 6/30** NCB_One-Play (L.J. Cryer's triple gives Cougars a 10-point lead) 2025/4/7 ESHEET

videos.headline: Thomas Haugh gets the and-1 after terrific block
videos.description: Thomas Haugh blocks a Houston 3-pointer that sets up a fantastic and-1 opportunity for Florida.

tracking.trackingName: **UNPUB 6/30** NCB_One-Play (Thomas Haugh gets the and-1 after terrific block) 2025/4/7 ESHEET

videos.headline: Walter Clayton Jr. finishes through contact for Gators
videos.description: Florida's Walter Clayton Jr. drives hard to the paint and gets the hoop and the harm vs. Houston.

tracking.trackingName: **UNPUB 6/30** NCB_One-Play (Walter Clayton Jr. finishes through contact for Gators) 2025/4/7 ESHEET

videos.headline: Ja'Vier Francis throws down massive putback jam for Houston
videos.description: Ja'Vier Francis elevates for the offensive rebound and gets the putback dunk vs. Florida.

tracking.trackingName: **UNPUB 6/30** NCB_One-Play (Ja'Vier Francis throws down massive putback jam for Houston) 2025/4/7 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kelvin Sampson explains what went wrong for Houston on final play
videos.description: Houston coach Kelvin Sampson explains the breakdown for Houston's offense that failed to get a shot off in the closing seconds vs. Florida.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCB Interview (Kelvin Sampson explains what went wrong for Houston on final play) 2025/4/8 SC

videos.headline: Greenberg impressed by Florida's competitiveness after title win
videos.description: Seth Greenberg and Jay Williams break down Florida's run to become the 2025 national champions.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCB Analysis (Greenberg impressed by Florida's competitiveness after title win) 2025/04/07 SC

videos.headline: Bilas breaks down how Florida overcame deficit vs. Houston
videos.description: Jay Bilas explains how the Gators erased a 12-point deficit in the second half to beat the Cougars for their third national championship.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCB Analysis (Bilas breaks down how Florida overcame deficit vs. Houston) 2025/4/7 SC
